TITLE: 600 Block (Central Ave.)
DETAILS: A view of a bustling downtown taken on Central Avenue looking south, taken in the 1940s. The grand McFarlan Hotel overlooks a J.C. Penney Company store below. That traffic certainly looks scary!
CREDIT: Allen County Public Library in Fort Wayne, Indiana

TITLE: The 1907 Tram Car and the Canal
DETAILS: In 1907, a tram car crashed into the canal. Luckily there were no injuries, but it sure made waves!
